children: Here's a list of key deals reported across sectors this week:
ARC Group Acquisition I
has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of Malaysian licensed financing company Firstborn Top Capital.
Copart
agreed to acquire ACV Auctions
for $10.50 a share in cash. The deal gives the digital dealer auction platform an implied equity value of about $1.9 billion.
Grab Holdings
is said to be in talks to purchase a majority stake in Singapore-based buy-now-pay-later platform Atome Financial.
Bending Spoons

has agreed to acquire collaborative-workspace company Miro at an enterprise value of $1.355 billion, the companies said on Thursday, in an all-cash transaction that is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026.
Meta Platforms
has purchased Swedish AI startup Stilla.ai to help in the development of Meta Business Agent, which facilitates transactions on WhatsApp, Messenger, and Instagram.
Analog Devices
will acquire Alif Semiconductor in an all-cash transaction for $1.35 billion, both companies said on Wednesday.
Apple

has acquired Sonera Magnetics, the European Commission disclosed on Tuesday. The acquisition occurred in early May but was only just reported due to the E.U.'s Digital Markets Act, which requires certain acquisitions be disclosed publicly. Apple is not required to disclose how much it paid for the acquisition.
GE Aerospace

said Tuesday it agreed to acquire Consolidated Precision Products for $11.75 billion, expanding its control over the supply of specialized castings used in commercial aircraft engines, military equipment and industrial gas turbines.
Tamarack Valley Energy
said Tuesday it agreed to
Headwater Exploration
in an all-stock deal valued at C$10B (~US$7.25B), creating the largest ‌publicly traded oil producer focused on Alberta's Clearwater formation.
Florida-based EverBank Financial ​agreed to acquire smaller Pacific Northwest bank WaFd
in a $3.9B reverse merger transaction, the companies said Monday, creating a regional bank with ~$75B in assets.
